manifest.name: 图腾信仰
manifest.description: 玩法插件示例（证明框架插入插件即加功能）：新建筑「图腾」（心情光环）+ 祈愿卡 + 祭典事件——事件走 defs.events 纯声明（DLC 形态，when 谓词 + effects 效果表），零代码
manifest.author: infcanvas

defs: {"buildings": [{"id": "totem", "name": "图腾", "size": {"x": 1, "y": 1}, "hp": 300, "color": "#7a4a6a", "emoji": "🗿", "passable": false, "buildTime": 6, "costWood": 10, "tags": ["totem", "faith"], "aura": {"radius": 5, "moodPerSec": 0.4}, "sprite": "building:monument"}], "events": [{"id": "totem_festival", "name": "图腾祭典", "weight": 3, "cooldown": 240, "minTime": 120, "when": ["hasTotem", "moodLow"], "effects": [{"kind": "mood", "amount": 8, "text": "🗿 图腾祭典举行，全营地心神振奋"}]}], "cards": [{"id": "totemPray", "name": "图腾祈愿", "series": "religion", "weight": 4, "when": ["hasTotem"], "utilityFixed": 15, "action": "idle", "label": "图腾祈愿", "satisfies": [{"desire": "pride", "amount": 1}]}]}
